name: Corner-based Voxel Volume Calculation
aliases: Corner-based Voxel Volume Calculation for DDA Raymarching
definition: A technique to compute voxel volume values at corners for smooth terrain rendering, replacing side-based volume storage with corner-based values to better represent surface geometry during raymarching.
summary: Corner-based Voxel Volume Calculation computes volume values at voxel corners to better represent surface geometry during raymarching, replacing side-based storage.
